notes.title: Demo Release: "Caution Ahead: Part 2" Now Available!
notes.notes:
Thrilled to announce that the demo for "Caution Ahead: Part 2" is now live and ready for you to explore!

In this installment, you will step back into the shoes of John Rand.

Separated from his team, John ventures deeper into the ominous Richburg National Park, confronting new challenges.

This demo offers a glimpse into the atmosphere, tension and horror elements of Part 2 and is available for download directly from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018940/Caution_Ahead_Part_2/]"Caution Ahead: Part 2" Steam page[/url].

notes.title: Update v1.6 – Minor bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Enhanced 3D Audio for Enemy Footsteps: Improved spatial audio cues for enemy movements, providing a more directional sound experience.
[*] Fixed HDR Configuration for Surveillance Cameras: Resolved issues with High Dynamic Range settings in surveillance camera feeds, eliminating bright color spots.
[*] Adjusted Subtitle Positioning: Moved subtitles to a higher vertical position on the screen to improve readability.

notes.title: Update v1.5 – Readable Items Visibility
notes.notes:
This minor update has a couple of tweaks based on gameplay insights:

[olist]
[*] Readable Item Highlights: To help players spot important lore-related items, I’ve added a subtle highlight to readable objects, making them easier to notice. Once you’ve read them, the highlight will disappear. This change should help it easier to find story elements.
[*] Radio Subtitle Timing: In Chapter 2, radio subtitles were lingering on-screen longer than needed. I’ve adjusted the timing so that subtitles now clear shortly after radio transmission ends, providing a more seamless experience.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update v1.3 – Gameplay Improvements Based on Player Feedback
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thank you again for your feedback on Caution Ahead: Part 1.

I’ve implemented a couple of changes in Update v1.3 to improve gameplay based on what I’ve heard from players:

[olist]
[*] Normalized Character Movement – Previously, character could move faster when running diagonally, which created an inconsistent feel to movement. This has now been adjusted to provide a more balanced and natural movement experience.
[*] Crouch Indicator Icon – Some players occasionally entered crouch mode unintentionally and didn’t immediately realize they were crouched, which interrupted gameplay. I’ve added a crouch icon to provide a clear visual indicator when you’re in crouch mode.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/olist]
Thank you again for helping improve the game! Keep sharing your thoughts as I continue to make adjustments.

notes.title: Update v1.1 – Gameplay & Audio Improvements Based on Player Feedback
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly Slower Walk Speed in Chapters 1 and 3, as some players felt the character was moving too fast even without sprinting, which broke immersion.
[*] Less Aggressive Flashlight Flickering in Chapters 1 and 2, as it was reported to be annoying for many players.
[/list]
[b]Audio Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Thunder Volume in Chapter 1 to ensure it doesn’t overpower the voice narration.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Release of "Caution Ahead: Part 1"
notes.notes:
Caution Ahead is an Indie Horror Game Inspired by My Fascination with Park Ranger Horror Stories.

I’ve always been fascinated by the eerie and mysterious horror stories surrounding park rangers and national parks. There’s something so unsettling about the idea of vast, isolated wilderness and the things that might lurk within it. I wanted to capture that feeling of unease and turn it into a game.

"Caution Ahead: Part 1" is my take on the terrifying unknowns that could exist in the national parks. The game is set to release on September 20th, and I'm really hoping it resonates with those who love horror stories as much as I do.
